faqs.question: How do I schedule a fleet maintenance check?
faqs.answer: Log in to your owner account, pick a vehicle, choose the services you need, and select a date and time. You'll receive an instant confirmation and can track progress in real time.

faqs.question: Can I book recurring services for multiple vehicles?
faqs.answer: Yes. The fleet plan supports recurring maintenance schedules across all registered vehicles with consolidated billing and predictive maintenance alerts.

faqs.question: What happens if I need to cancel or reschedule a booking?
faqs.answer: You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 24 hours before your appointment from the Appointments page in your dashboard.

faqs.question: Is emergency roadside assistance available 24/7?
faqs.answer: Yes, emergency roadside assistance is available around the clock for Premium Care members. Contact support anytime for immediate dispatch.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to book a service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Create a free owner account with your NID and driving license for verification. Once approved you can register vehicles and book instantly. Guests can browse services and pricing without an account.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Pay securely by card online through Stripe Checkout, or with cash and mobile money at the workshop. Every payment issues a digital receipt instantly.

faqs.question: Is paying online safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Card payments run on a Stripe-hosted checkout page, so we never see or store your card details.

faqs.question: What happens if my online payment fails or I close the checkout?
faqs.answer: Nothing is charged and your invoice stays UNPAID. You can retry anytime from the Payments page or settle the bill at vehicle pickup.

faqs.question: Can I pay for multiple jobs separately?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each completed job generates its own invoice, so fleet owners can settle vehicles one at a time as work finishes.

faqs.question: What are the stages of my repair?
faqs.answer: Every job moves through Received, Inspecting, Repairing, Testing, and Ready. Follow each step live from the Service Tracking page.

faqs.question: How long will my service take?
faqs.answer: Each service lists an estimated duration, for example Oil Change takes 30 minutes and Brake Service takes 2 hours. Your advisor confirms a completion estimate when your vehicle is received.

faqs.question: Do you use genuine quality parts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We fit quality parts from trusted suppliers only, and every part used is listed on your job card and invoice with its quantity and price.

faqs.question: Can I visit or check on my vehicle during the repair?
faqs.answer: The workshop floor is restricted for safety, but your advisor shares progress notes and repair photos, and you can message them anytime from the chat.

faqs.question: What happens if the mechanic finds extra problems?
faqs.answer: Work pauses and you receive a digital cost estimate for the additional repairs. Nothing extra is ever done without your explicit approval.

faqs.question: Can I approve extra repair costs before you start?
faqs.answer: Yes. If the workshop finds additional repairs needed, you'll get a digital estimate. You can approve or reject it — no work happens without your approval.

faqs.question: How is my estimate calculated?
faqs.answer: Services are priced from our published list, plus parts at supplier rates and labor, with 8.5% tax shown as a separate line. There are no hidden fees.

faqs.question: How long do I have to decide on an estimate?
faqs.answer: Estimates stay pending until you approve or reject them from the Estimates page. The related work simply waits until you decide.

faqs.question: What happens if I reject an estimate?
faqs.answer: Only the work you approved proceeds. Rejected items are removed from the job and the repair continues with the original agreed scope.

faqs.question: How do I track my vehicle's repair progress?
faqs.answer: Follow your vehicle through the live status timeline: Received → Inspecting → Repairing → Testing → Ready. You can also chat with your service advisor anytime.

faqs.question: Will I be notified when the status changes?
faqs.answer: Yes. The timeline updates in real time on your dashboard, and your advisor can message you directly in the Communication Center.

faqs.question: What should I do if my repair is taking longer than estimated?
faqs.answer: Message your advisor from the job or chat page for an updated completion time. Delays such as parts sourcing are always communicated before you are charged anything extra.

faqs.question: Can I see the full service history of a vehicle?
faqs.answer: Yes. Service History keeps every completed job per vehicle with its invoices, parts used, and your ratings, all in one place.

faqs.question: Do your repairs come with a warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes. All workmanship is covered. If a fault with our repair recurs within the warranty period, bring the vehicle back for re-inspection free of charge.

faqs.question: Are the replaced parts covered too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Parts carry their manufacturer or supplier warranty on top of our labor cover. Keep your invoice as proof of purchase.

faqs.question: What voids the warranty?
faqs.answer: Later third-party modifications, accident damage, or normal wear outside the cover period. Your advisor always confirms coverage before any chargeable rework.

faqs.question: How do I claim warranty service?
faqs.answer: Book a follow-up appointment referencing the original job card or invoice number. The advisor verifies coverage when your vehicle arrives.

faqs.question: When do I receive my invoice?
faqs.answer: Automatically, as soon as your job is marked complete. Find it under Payments with full line items for services, parts, labor, and 8.5% tax.

faqs.question: Can I download or print my invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every invoice downloads as a PDF, handy for your records, fleet accounting, or reimbursement.

faqs.question: What do the PAID and UNPAID labels mean?
faqs.answer: UNPAID invoices are awaiting settlement, either online by card or in person. PAID confirms receipt with the payment method and date recorded.

faqs.question: I think my invoice is wrong. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Message your advisor from the invoice or chat page before paying. Corrections are issued as an updated invoice, never as an unexplained side charge.

faqs.question: How do I contact my service advisor?
faqs.answer: Open the Communication Center from your dashboard to chat directly with your advisor. Every conversation stays linked to your vehicles and jobs.

faqs.question: My account is still pending verification. Why?
faqs.answer: New owner accounts need a review of the NID and driving license documents you uploaded. This usually completes within one business day, and booking unlocks right after approval.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
faqs.answer: Use the Forgot Password link on the login page and we will email you a secure reset link.

faqs.question: Where can I leave feedback about my service?
faqs.answer: Rate any completed job from Service History with a score and review. Your feedback helps the workshop improve and guides other owners.

cta.title: Still Need Help?
cta.subtitle: If you couldn't find the answer to your question, our dedicated fleet support team is ready to assist you with tailored solutions.
